posts.summary_en: The 10-08 update (maintenance that day): new SSR Chardonnay, main stages to 364-30, Gnome Lab basic research to 130-2 and special research to 22, cookie level cap 100 → 120, Rumble Arena season 2, new collections (4 cookie, 1 pet). Cookie EXP for levels 79–100 is cut, and EXP spent past the new costs comes back by mail. Gnome Lab research takes at most 12 hours per level; research that took longer is refunded in 1-minute speed-ups. Rift season-2 stage rewards add Syrup Metal, an SSR choice box and speed-ups; the Rift season-2 exchange sells more Chocosteel and Syrup Metal; the mileage exchange adds Chocosteel and Syrup Metal. A new 7-day check-in gives Milk (바삭튼튼 소아과 의사 우유맛 쿠키) with growth materials. Daily dungeons are made easier (EXP, dough, research stone dungeons) but not extended. Commenters complain the daily dungeons weren't extended past 770 and the plating shatter wasn't touched; one welcomes the Syrup in the mileage shop; one says the free Milk is good for new players.

datapoints.note: every level 79–100 is listed old → new; excess EXP refunded

datapoints.after: Chocosteel and Syrup Metal in the mileage exchange; more of both in the Rift S2 exchange; Syrup in Rift S2 stage rewards

quotes.en: Cookie EXP spent beyond the changed level-up costs is refunded through the mailbox after the update.

quotes.kr: 노움 연구소 연구 항목의 최대 소요 시간이 12시간으로 개선됩니다.
quotes.en: The longest Gnome Lab research now takes 12 hours.

quotes.kr: 7일 동안 매일 접속하여 다양한 성장 재화와 함께 바삭튼튼 소아과 의사 우유맛 쿠키를 만나보세요!

posts.title_kr: 오븐 자동 열기 기능 개선 및 일일 던전 난이도 완화 안내 (18:43 내용 추가)
posts.title_en: Oven auto-open improved (from 10-02); daily dungeons to be eased
posts.summary_en: From 2026-10-02 15:00 KST the oven's auto-open opens 200 dough at a time at oven 32, 300 at 34, 400 at 36 and 500 at 38 (oven 30 and below unchanged), and the auto-open result holds 100 pieces of gear instead of 30. A bug that stopped auto-open when a sort pop-up appeared is fixed on 10-08. Commenters had been unable to open their dough in a day (one holds 1.8M dough); some still ask for 1,000 at a time.

datapoints.before: auto-open up to 50 per open; 30 gear held
datapoints.after: 200 / 300 / 400 / 500 per open at oven 32 / 34 / 36 / 38; 100 gear held
datapoints.note: the 50 is crumb.gg's 08-27 figure (first round); official from 10-02
